::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 11th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 32
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Please let me have the rest of the [Primer](cmy_books/cmybook_353.qmd) I thought I had it all, but I cannot find further than what I send.

I am waiting for [Mr Freeman](people/person_523.qmd)’s orders before I send back [the French history](cmy_books/cmybook_99.qmd)

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
